categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in nano-coloring materials, functional nano-dispersions, and specialty additives. It has established four major industrial bases in Kunshan, Changshu, Yueyang, and Panjin. The Kunshan and Changshu bases focus on nano-coloring materials and functional nano-dispersions for applications in coatings, textiles, and medical protection. The Yueyang base (Kaimen Additives) produces electronic chemicals and eco-friendly additives for coatings, inks, photovoltaic processing, and lithium battery preparation. The Panjin base focuses on specialty photosensitive materials, electronic-grade hydrocarbon resins, and specialty lubricant additives.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies including pigment nano-modification and surface treatment, nano-grinding and dispersion techniques, and polymer additive preparation methods. It operates standardized production processes with quality control systems. The company has developed advanced research facilities and possesses 109 patents (73 invention patents and 36 utility model patents). Key technologies include water-based color paste production, fiber original liquid coloring, functional nano-dispersions, and electronic-grade materials manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse industries including coatings (72.06% of 2023 revenue), textiles (22.98%), and photovoltaic/electronic sectors (3.97%). Primary customer types include paint manufacturers, textile fiber producers, medical device manufacturers, and electronics companies. The company has established long-term relationships with leading domestic enterprises and serves as a supplier to major coating and textile companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major presence in East China (47.36% of 2023 revenue), North China (21.22%), South China (14.74%), and Central China (10.51%). Key operating locations include Kunshan and Changshu in Jiangsu Province, Yueyang in Hunan Province, and Panjin in Liaoning Province. The company also maintains limited international sales (0.53% of revenue).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It sources raw materials (pigments, additives, resins) from upstream suppliers and sells finished products (color pastes, functional dispersions, additives) to downstream manufacturers in coatings, textiles, and electronics industries. The company also provides application solutions and technical support to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on 'aggregating new energy, exploring new materials, and leading the future.' Key R&D initiatives include: developing high-performance fiber original liquid coloring materials, advancing electronic-grade materials (UV monomers, photosensitive resins, hydrocarbon resins), expanding into energy storage batteries (zinc-nickel batteries), and improving environmental performance. The company invested 62.24 million yuan in R&D in 2023 (9.13% of revenue) and collaborates with leading universities on advanced materials research.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of color pastes, functional additives, and specialty materials. It employs both direct sales (45.69% of 2023 revenue) and distribution channels (54.31%). Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, typically upon delivery for domestic sales or shipment for export sales. The company also provides technical services and application solutions to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of nano-coloring materials and functional nano-dispersions. It competes with both domestic and international chemical companies. The company emphasizes its advantages in product quality, technical innovation, environmental performance, and customer service. It has established strong brand recognition in the coatings and textiles industries and maintains competitive advantages through continuous R&D and product differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized chemical manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 681.59 million yuan, representing 9.31% growth from 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 18.01 million yuan in 2023 (down 37.56% from 2022 due to one-time items). Total assets reached 1.09 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company has shown steady growth in recent years with expanding product portfolios and geographic presence, though profitability was impacted by market conditions and project ramp-up costs in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through: (1) advanced nano-technology enabling superior product performance and environmental compliance; (2) comprehensive product portfolio addressing diverse customer needs; (3) strong technical support and customized solutions; (4) environmental leadership with low-VOC, APEO-free products meeting international standards; (5) domestic substitution capabilities reducing customer dependence on imports; (6) integrated service model combining products with technical consultation and application support.
